resources.string: Manage Xposed modules and app scopes without re-patching
LSPatch requires Android 9 or newer. Other MP Manager tools remain available.

Manager-mode apps load their framework and scoped modules from MP Manager Full. Keep Full installed. Module changes apply when the target app restarts; compatible modern modules also support hot reload. Only enable modules you trust.
No managed apps yet. Patch an APK in Manager mode to bind it to this app.
No supported Xposed modules are installed. Install a module APK first. Legacy and libxposed API 101+ modules are supported; API 100 modules are not.
Scope saved. Restart the target app to apply module changes; no re-patch is needed.
%1$s was created in Manager mode. It requires MP Manager Full to stay installed. Change its modules in Tools → LSPatch manager. Install it?
No running modern-module targets. Restart the target app to apply changes.
Remove this app’s module configuration? The installed app and generated APK are not deleted.
The original app file is missing. Select a new APK before re-patching.
